CustomField.description: The varRecId value from the Unsubscribe Link that created this Request: C or L followed by the Contact or Lead Public Id. Legacy links from the unmanaged app carry a Contact or Lead record Id instead. Blank for Requests typed in by email address.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The link value that created this Request. C or L followed by the Public Id of the Contact or Lead. Blank when the Recipient typed in an email address.
CustomField.label: Public Id
